changeSet.author: hugmesh
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO games (id, name, description, slug, sort_order, created_at) SELECT (SELECT COALESCE(MAX(id), 0) + 1 FROM games), 'Character Forge', '3D character maker for the HugMesh platform. Build an anime / FF / furry / D&D-style character on a procedural parametric rig (29 head families, body sliders, part attachments, per-joint rig adjustments with auto-fit, 7 tint regions, the 10 canonical expressions), spin it on the turntable, and randomize with archetype-coherent seeds. The same definition drives your avatar in Shadows of the Net - CHAT rooms and your live-stream avatar cam.', 'character-forge', (SELECT COALESCE(MAX(sort_order), 0) + 1 FROM games), NOW() WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM games WHERE slug = 'character-forge');

changeSet.author: hugmesh
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO chapters (name, description, slug, scene_type, sort_order, asset_url, scene_config, game_id, created_at) SELECT 'Forge Studio', 'The turntable stage: your character on a lit platform, orbit and zoom with the mouse, every parameter driven from the Angular editor over the CharForge bridge.', 'character-forge', 'character-forge', 1, '/_remotes/wasm-fragment/character-forge/index.html', '{"chromeless": true}', (SELECT id FROM games WHERE slug = 'character-forge'), NOW() WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM chapters WHERE slug = 'character-forge');

changeSet.author: hugmesh
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO federation_modules (slug, display_name, kind, remote_entry_url, exposed_module, game_slug, version, enabled, metadata) VALUES ('games-character-forge', 'Character Forge', 'wasm-game', '/_remotes/wasm-fragment/character-forge/index.html', NULL, 'character-forge', '0.2.0', true, '{"sse":false,"hostAuthoritative":false,"engine":"godot","singlePlayer":true,"bridge":"CharForge","hostOwnsControls":true}'::jsonb) ON CONFLICT (slug) DO NOTHING;

changeSet.author: hugmesh
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO game_access (game_id, scope, scope_value, granted_by, granted_at) SELECT g.id, 'all', NULL, 'system:migration-062', NOW() FROM games g WHERE g.slug = 'character-forge' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM game_access ga WHERE ga.game_id = g.id AND ga.scope = 'all');
